'''Bialar Selis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] who served in the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a rising star in the Guard and led the investigation for the stolen [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]].<ref name="SWI" /> Bialar was present just prior to the [[Occupation of Bespin]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], accompanying [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to [[Platform 327/Legends|Platform 327]] to meet [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] for the first time in several years. Selis, alongside fellow Wing Guardsmen [[Corman Jeihn]], [[Pedar Solardo/Legends|Pedar Solardo]], [[Gir Endac]], [[Helder Spinoza/Legends|Helder Spinoza]], and [[Razell Tameron]], proceeded to ambush an Imperial unit led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sheckil/Legends|Sheckil]] while they were transporting [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to Vader's shuttle, having been secretly notified by Calrissian via Lobot.
